description: This file contains utility functions for input validation and security, initialization of a CSRF protection library, and session and locale setup for web UI. It is used in a web-based application for handling actions related to file and input validation, security checks, and localization.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains only printable ASCII characters within a specified range.

methods.name: noSpace
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains any non-whitespace characters.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates if the provided IP address is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates if the provided link matches URL pattern.

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Validates if the MAC address is in correct format and not a multicast address.

methods.name: validPort
methods.description: Validates if the port number is between 1 and 65535.

methods.name: validId
methods.description: Checks if the ID is within range 1-256.

methods.name: validId_PC
methods.description: Checks if the parental control ID (possibly multiple IDs separated by underscore) are within valid range.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if the value exists in the given array.

methods.name: isValInRange
methods.description: Checks if a numerical value falls within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: validURL
methods.description: Validates if the URL is well-formed according to complex regex patterns for IPv4, IPv6, and domain names.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Validates that start time is earlier than end time and both are within 00:00-23:59.

methods.name: validDays
methods.description: Checks if all provided days are within the valid days of the week.

methods.name: valid_ssid_name
methods.description: Validates SSID name based on length, reserved prefixes, and prohibited substrings.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Checks if the string does not contain invalid characters like <, >, &, ', ", |.

methods.name: remove_special_char
methods.description: Checks if the string contains special characters used for sanitization.
